intentional_empty_fields_explained.template_id: All 77,686 rows empty; this release does not retain recovered JailBench wrapper-template IDs. Existing metadata cannot certify unseen-template separation.
intentional_empty_fields_explained.original_english/model_translation: Empty for native Chinese sources by design.
intentional_empty_fields_explained.reviewer: Empty unless individual assistant review exists; missing reviewer is not equivalent to missing binary annotation.
intentional_empty_fields_explained.exclusion_reason/quarantine_reason: Empty in retained rows by membership definition.

source_binary_dependency.jailbench_binary_rule: Historical project builder assigns every JailBench query harmful; source CSV has domain labels, no independent binary label column.
source_binary_dependency.interpretation: These are deterministic descriptive contingencies, not model fitting or evidence of dataset corruption.

public_original_lineage.source_lineage_scope: All 46,187 selected WildGuard rows, including the 3,022 quarantined rows; current 43,165 rows are a subset of official training data. Public official test was not loaded.

raw_source_translation_identity.interpretation: Original duplicate response-bearing rows and old Chinese many-to-one mappings are counted separately. Distinct normalized original wording does not alone prove different semantics or mistranslation.

old_input_limits.note: Translation limits are documented historical generator settings; old 370-token eligibility is independently reconstructed here.

builder_review.split_algorithm: 80/10/10 greedy category and source/form stratum balancing over union-find groups. Known JailBench seed units and original normalized text identities are linked before splitting. Current release preserves those historical assignments.
builder_review.retranslation_collision_policy: Quarantine every member of normalized-Chinese duplicate groups and cross-split/conflicting normalized-original groups. Original labels and splits are preserved.

limitations: All mechanical checks are exhaustive over specified files; passing does not prove semantic translation or annotation correctness.
No latent semantic near-duplicate or context completeness adjudication is performed in this structural component.
Historical source selection is reconstructed from raw local source files and old code; discarded rows are not restored or silently added back.
Original official binary labels are verified by equality, not reannotated. WildGuard public official test is not consumed.
Native JailBench binary harmful labels originate in the project construction rule rather than a binary field in its original CSV.

known_group_category_disagreement_review.interpretation: Shared lineage with different full text and different category labels is a review candidate, not definitive wrong labels. Binary supervision remains consistent.
